features: Suite inventories resolve relative targets using the native effective cwd before collecting or hashing source files. Physical cwd and root paths normalize symlink and dot aliases for provenance.
Absolute and relative spellings of a common root are accepted together. Overlapping directory/file selections preserve native deduplication and one source-inventory entry per canonical file.

Controls compare ordinary relative-cwd, symlink-cwd, root-alias and overlapping-target execution with direct native execution. Requested symlink spelling in process.cwd remains native-owned. Missing preliminary journals are explicitly recorded.
limitations: Twenty-three native groups passed in the initial batch; its suite group failed an incorrect symlink-cwd fixture expectation. After matching native cwd semantics, the changed suite passes with 26 reports; the other 23 groups were unchanged. This is combined verification of 24 groups, not a claim that the initial batch was green.
The nine original selected files retain 62 passes, three process checks, one failure/failed file (#874), 40 filtered cases and zero skips/TODOs. Original assertions and snapshots are unchanged.

The initial relative-cwd run failed before creating a journal, and its partial retained reports remain visible. Interrupted/write-failure controls remain incomplete.
